subtitle: Lesson 22 · Inner Product Spaces, Unitary & Hermitian Operators

steps.label: The diagonal entries must be real
steps.sub: A complex number only equals its own conjugate if its imaginary part is zero

steps.label: Off-diagonal entries must be conjugates of each other

code:
A = [[2,1-2i],[1+2i,-1]]:  diagonal real, (1-2i)*=1+2i matches -> Hermitian

B = [[1,2+i],[3-i,4]]:  diagonal real, but (2+i)*=2-i != 3-i -> NOT Hermitian
caption: Both checks must pass — a real diagonal alone is never enough.
Even with complex off-diagonal entries, a Hermitian matrix's eigenvalues always come out real.
